messages:
sara_sales: Quick sync — Acme POC kickoff. They need MSA + DPA signed, a custom SLA (99.9 read latency), and an order form with tenant-level billing. Also asking whether reserved capacity discount can be applied to POC billing. cc @kevin_legal for redlines and @luo_se for technical presales
luo_se: Thanks. Two quick things: 1) they want KMS/HSM integration in the DPA — do we have standard language or we need an addendum? 2) sequence length and concurrency looks like 512 tokens, ~200 qps peak for test workload. That pushes toward Dedicated pools for the eval.
paul_sales: Pricing Q: can we offer a short-term reserved tranche for the POC (30 days) at a pro-rated commit? Or must we do pay-as-you-go for trials?
maria_ops: For order form — we usually include: billing entity, billing contact, POC start/end dates, seats/commit units, monthly commit amount, overage rate, support tier. I can draft. Also need signer mapping (who signs for payment vs legal).
kevin_legal: Please send the MSA redlines. For KMS/HSM, we have an HSM addendum template but it requires security review + attestation. If they need HSM key custody, that may push to Private deployment or dedicated enclave — flagging Ops.
sara_sales: Attached the initial Acme counterparty details in the workspace (link). They requested net45 payment, and one exec signer + procurement signer.
luo_se: Re: Dedicated for POC — we can spin a small Dedicated pool. Ops: what's lead time for a short-lived Dedicated instance? @maria_ops
maria_ops: Lead time usually 48-72h if GPU capacity is available. For Dedicated we need an order form with commit units and an SOC2/Onboarding checklist. If they insist on HSM, add 5-7 days for attestation and entitlements.
paul_sales: Legal asked whether we can accept a few customer-proposed SLA edits: 1) include uptime credits for API-level SLOs 2) stricter incident notification windows. We prefer service credits schedule; cannot commit to lower response times without support upgrade.
kevin_legal: Agreed. We can accept standard uptime credits but will push back on hard incident SLA without an enhanced support tier. I'll prepare a redline highlighting: SLA credits table, incident notif windows (we can offer 1h for sev1 with priority support add-on), limitation of liability clauses.
sara_sales: Can you also confirm signature routing? They want DocuSign with countersign for Exec + Procurement. Any objections to using DocuSign?
maria_ops: DocuSign is fine. We need the signers' emails and whether they require multi-signer ordering (exec first, procurement second). Also set PO number field for billing.
luo_se: For the technical side, I'll prepare a short runbook and a templated config for: model variant, batch size, kv-cache warmup, and suggested quantization profile. Will attach to the order form as 'runbook appendix'.
kevin_legal: Upload the MSA redline by EOD. I'll also include the HSM addendum as a separate file and mark optional. If they sign HSM addendum we need PO + SOC2 cross-check.
sara_sales: Noted. Action items: 1) @kevin_legal upload MSA redline 2) @maria_ops draft order form template + signer mapping 3) @luo_se deliver runbook appendix + sizing recs 4) @paul_sales confirm pricing (reserved tranche) with finance.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Esign envelope created (envelope id xZ-4932). Status: draft.
paul_sales: FYI finance okayed a 30-day pro-rated reserved option at 50% of list for POC if committed units >= 1000 token-units/day. I'll confirm exact numbers tomorrow.
kevin_legal: Uploaded redline: /files/MSA_Acme_redline_v1.pdf. Highlights: remove broad indemnity for customer, SLA schedule appended, HSM addendum attached. Please review and add in-thread comments.
sara_sales: Reviewed. I left inline comments on the indemnity language (section 8). Also added procurement contact info for signer mapping.
maria_ops: Draft order form uploaded: /files/Acme_orderform_draft_v1.docx. Includes PO field, sign order, billing contact, start/end date. Please confirm and I'll move to DocuSign.
luo_se: Attach runbook here: /files/Acme_runbook_v1.md. Includes recommended model (redwood/gpt-xxl-quant), batch config, and warmup steps.
paul_sales: I'll assemble a pricing sheet and send to the thread tomorrow AM. If legal approves the redline with SLA credits, we can proceed to DocuSign by EOD.
kevin_legal: I'll aim to finish review first thing tomorrow. If Acme insists on HSM and private deploy, note that procurement and engineering approvals are required.
sara_sales: Thanks everyone. Next sync tomorrow 10am PT. Please flag any blockers in the thread before then. :thumbsup:
